title: Otori Emu — The Smiles I Want to Protect〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Smiles I Want to Protect（2★）

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bath time♪ Bath time♪
Bubbly, bubbly... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Keisuke and Shosuke!
Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're home.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We're back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How was work?
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Same old... Hm? Why are you grinning like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I dunno.
But I feel really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Good for you? I suppose this is par for the course when it comes to you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
No matter...
More importantly, when is your troupe next scheduled to all meet?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You mean Tsukasa, Nene and Rui?
We'll be practicing all week, so anytime during the evening should be okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you'll come and see our show?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What are you talking about? We have some business to discuss with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Business?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we need to brief you and your troupe on your first assignment as ambassadors. We have much to discuss.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Our first assignment?!
Yay! They're gonna be so happy when they hear this♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: W-Well, we still have to hammer out the details...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
Can't we just have the site manager do this...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: No, Phoenix Wonderland depends on this, so it's imperative that we're involved in this process.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We also owe it to Emu and her friends for reminding us about what truly matters most.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And it's our turn to prove it to them.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll be by later to give your troupe a fuller explanation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks, guys!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Guh!
What did I say about tackling me?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry!
So where's our first stop gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, I said we'll stop by once we hammer out the details.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, but how about a hint?
Just an incy-wincy one♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I don't see why not, Shosuke.
There's honestly nothing to hide.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We can dive into the details later, but it looks like you'll be performing on a stage by the sea that's right on the beach...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The beach...?!
Yay!! That's great!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Okay, just keep it down...
Also, didn't you just come back from the Seaside School?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, but I didn't get to go with Tsukasa, Nene and Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been wanting to go to the beach with all of them too♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we suspected as much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You guys knew already?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: No, your mascot friend told us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. Soon after that, Shosuke found a suitable location that happened to be right on the beach...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
K-Keisuke!
You're making it sound like I chose this venue just for her!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: For your information, that isn't the case whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It happened to be the most optimal location from a business standpoint in terms of location and potential for promoting the park.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Otherwise, we wouldn't be sending you there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whatever you say...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Why are you grinning?
If you're still not convinced, you can see the data for yourself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not that, Shosuke♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm just really really happy that we get to work together on something together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So let's do the best we can, Shosuke, Keisuke☆

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, that's the plan.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, we get it.
Go take your bath already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The sea♪ The sand♪
Everybody at the beach♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Great, she's skipping now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's been a while since this house has had such a lively atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I think I preferred it more when things were quiet.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But it's nice to see Emu smiling like this again...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We may've been guilty of robbing her of that all this time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now, we need to protect that smile.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Not just our family either. We need to make sure everybody who comes to visit Phoenix Wonderland also goes home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...
